title: FileNotFoundError in config.load when starting the application
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice version 3.0.7; operating system Fedora 41 Workstation; server region ap-south-1.

STEPS:

How to trigger it:
* Start by starting the application.
* Start two jobs on the same folder at the same time.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

EXPECTED:

As on every earlier run, starting the application should just complete.

ACTUAL:

It reports a missing file that turns out to exist seconds later. It only happens when two jobs touch the same folder at once.

FREQUENCY:

Happens roughly one run in three.
stacktrace:
lattice/cli.py:9 in main
lattice/core/app.py:30 in start
lattice/core/boot.py:100 in load_all
lattice/core/config.py:118 in load
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: 'conf\core.toml'
